'''Jabba's Palace Limited''' is the 12th expansion of Star Wars CCG, published by Decipher in April 1998. It is 180 cards (90 Light Side and 90 Dark Side): 80 rares, 50 uncommons, and 50 commons. Black border. CardGuide numbering: 12th product.

It is the first expansion from ''Return of the Jedi'', covering the opening of the film and the rescue of Han Solo from Jabba the Hutt. Debuts include [[Jabba the Hutt]], [[Princess Leia Organa]], [[Artoo (Jabba's Palace)|Artoo]], and a large cast of aliens at the palace. Like [[Cloud City Limited]], it was sold in 9-card packs (MSRP $2.50), with the last card always the rare.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="wook">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jabba%27s_Palace_Limited Jabba's Palace Limited] at Wookieepedia</ref>

== Packaging ==
Limited Edition was sold in 9-card booster packs (MSRP $2.50: 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare) and 60-pack booster boxes. Each box included a fold-out Rules Supplement / card list.<ref name="encyc" />

== Memorabilia ==
Decipher issued a four-panel poster (~32&Prime; &times; 10.5&Prime;) for every expansion from Premiere through Death Star II. Jabba's Palace reverse is the expansion card list.<ref name="encyc" />

[[File:Jabbas-Palace-Limited-four-panel-poster.png|360px|Jabba's Palace Limited four-panel poster front]]
[[File:Jabbas-Palace-Limited-four-panel-poster-back.png|360px|Jabba's Palace Limited four-panel poster reverse]]

''Front and reverse (Light Side / Dark Side card list)''

The booster box held the fold-out Jabba's Palace Rules Supplement (new rules, including Tatooine / Jabba's Palace location deployment, on one side; card list on the other).<ref name="encyc" />

== Print sheets ==
Rares are 8&times;10 (80 cards): 40 rares twice per sheet. Uncommons and commons are each 10&times;10 (100 cards): 25 titles four times per sheet. The encyclopedia recreations below are labeled as recreations for clarity.<ref name="encyc" />
